name: Freedom Force
description: Freedom Force is a singleplayer and multiplayer real-time tactics role-playing game and the first in the Freedom Force series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Freedom Force starts with its sound driver set to "any" instead of "Creative Labs EAX 2 (TM)".

audio_settings.title: Enable stereo sound
audio_settings.reason: Freedom Force mixes its sound for the speaker layout chosen in its Audio Options, which starts on stereo.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphone sound
audio_settings.reason: Freedom Force starts on stereo, so its sound isn't mixed for headphones.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround
audio_settings.reason: Freedom Force starts on stereo, so its sound isn't mixed for surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Freedom Force starts on stereo, so it doesn't send sound to four speakers.
